Use case: stylized-concept.
Original production concept art for a survival game's abandoned subtropical coastal city, generations into plant reclamation. Invent everything from these words; no photographic sources, no existing game art.
Style: exceptional finished game environment concept painting, stylized realism, substantial sculptural shapes, rich believable materials, selective painterly detail. Warm late-afternoon sunlight from upper left, cool blue skylight filling real shadows; no orange filter, no cinematic blur. The design must be buildable as scripted 3D trees with cut-out leaf cards. Leaves form deliberate irregular terminal clusters with clear sky holes, not uniform fuzzy balls or granular noise.
Output: a single PNG image at the largest native resolution available, no watermark or decorative frame.
Asset: hammock_far.png, the most important distant readability painting. Wide 16:9 composition, request 3840 x 2160.
Camera: view from across a bay, looking at a low coastal hillside roughly 400 metres away, moderately elevated eye line. Absolutely no giant foreground tree. Individual mature broadleaf trees should occupy only 3-6 percent of image height; shore mangroves 1.5-3 percent. Many dozens of trees, not a handful of near hero trees.
Scene: still muted blue-green bay occupies bottom quarter. A shallow curving shore runs from lower left to mid-right; beyond it a low hill with the broken skeletal remains of a concrete subtropical city. A partly collapsed square portico at left shore, one rust-stained rectangular midrise shell just right of centre, and a broken elevated road on the right create landmarks, all secondary to the forest. Small sky area above hill.
Tree language must remain distinct even when the picture is reduced: strangler figs are broad dark green domes 14-18 m tall, 18-24 m across with pale grey compact braided trunks, flat heavy lateral limbs and sparse hairlike aerial-root veils. Oaks are lower, wider, irregular spreading tiered silhouettes 12-16 m tall and 18-24 m across, dark trunks and sweeping low elbow-shaped limbs with grey-green moss accents. Mangroves are a continuous low scalloped band along the water, 5-8 m high and wide, dark glossy green foliage on glimpsed pale grey-brown compact prop-root cages. A few palms, slender trunks and distinct feather crowns, stand above the broadleaf canopy, irregularly spaced.
Compose light so pale fig stems can be glimpsed in some shoreline openings and oak dark horizontal branches in other gaps. Deliberate grouped crown masses and patches of shadow separate individuals and species; readable silhouettes, not millions of speckled leaves. Figs olive-dark evergreen, oaks slightly cooler and flatter-spreading, mangroves deepest glossy bottle green. Mix ages, heights, broken tops, asymmetries and ruins; no cloned trees in rows. Broad calm colour masses, atmospheric depth but enough clarity to see structure. No text, people, boats or UI.
